summary:
**AETHERRAXIS – Beyond Earth. Beyond Limits.**

AETHERRAXIS is an immersive space exploration and simulation game where players become engineers, astronauts, and mission commanders. Design and build your own rockets, satellites, and planetary rovers using customizable components and realistic engineering principles. Launch missions into space, manage spacecraft systems, monitor live telemetry, and deploy satellites into orbit. Explore the Moon and Mars through challenging missions, transport custom-built rovers, perform safe landings, and navigate alien landscapes while completing scientific objectives. Manage fuel, battery power, speed, and other resources as you overcome unexpected challenges. Experience different planetary environments, gravity conditions, and terrain while making decisions that affect mission success. Players can also compete or collaborate through multiplayer missions, share achievements, and compare engineering performance. Every mission produces a performance report based on actual gameplay events. With creativity, strategy, science, and adventure combined, AETHERRAXIS challenges players to build, explore, experiment, and push the boundaries of space exploration.
details:
AETHERRAXIS – Beyond Earth. Beyond Limits.

AETHERRAXIS is an interactive space exploration and simulation game that allows players to experience the challenges of designing spacecraft, launching missions, and exploring other worlds. Players can build and customize rockets, satellites, and planetary rovers, manage fuel and other resources, perform launches, and complete exploration missions on the Moon and Mars. The game aims to connect engineering, science, creativity, and entertainment through interactive gameplay.

The project benefits users by introducing concepts such as rocket engineering, orbital mechanics, planetary environments, physics, resource management, and problem-solving in an engaging way. Its intended impact is to encourage curiosity about space science, inspire future scientists and engineers, and make space exploration concepts more accessible to students and gaming enthusiasts.

The project is being developed using Google AI Studio and Gemini, with the existing application's technology and codebase being extended. The planned technical architecture includes JavaScript or TypeScript, interactive 3D graphics, physics simulations, data visualization, and multiplayer technologies, depending on the capabilities of the existing application.

The creative aspect of AETHERRAXIS is its combination of spacecraft construction, realistic mission management, lunar and Martian rover exploration, and multiplayer challenges in one experience. Players are not simply observers; they make engineering decisions that influence mission outcomes.

Important factors considered include scientific accuracy, realistic resource limitations, different planetary conditions, user-friendly controls, accessibility, performance, educational value, and meaningful mission success and failure reports.
